name: The Listening Sphere
visual_description: A round, stub-legged construct with enormous twin spirals, like conch shells listening to the void. Tubes stretch from its core into the unknown.
meaning: Surveillance as sorrow. Longing disguised as vigilance.
existential_reflection: **Mizontresh kept trying to hear a reply.** Even after extinction. This is the shape of a question still echoing, waiting for a voice to come back through the static.
